ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio characterized by a predominantly low-intensity (black) background base interspersed with high-intensity (white) linear pixel clusters occupying approximately 35-40% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density distribution of white linear strokes across both lobes; focal clusters of light-tan pixels at the distal tips; right lobe displays a higher concentration of intersecting white pixel segments than the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white and tan pixel groups at the terminal distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering the majority of the visible fluke surface, particularly concentrated on the medial regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Systemic presence of linear white scarring (rake marks) and irregular, high-intensity pigmentation at the fluke margins and tips indicating historical biological interaction or colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and intersection frequency of the linear rake marks create a unique high-frequency texture map across the ventral surface.
